SiteMedia.title: SiteMedia
SiteMedia.description: Media assets and photos displayed across public Stackd Bombay website sections (About, Philosophy, Packaging)

mediaId.description: Unique key for the section media: founder, ingredients, or tin

url.description: Shared public media URL or data URL for the image asset

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the media was last updated

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the admin who updated the media

ReelItem.title: ReelItem
ReelItem.description: Customer review video reel item displayed in the vertical Reel Wall customer reviews section

id.description: Unique identifier for the video reel

name.description: Title or display name for the reel

quote.description: Quote highlight from the customer review

instagramUrl.description: Link to original Instagram Reel or post

videoUrl.description: Shared public video URL or cloud storage URL

order.description: Display order index in the carousel

updatedBy.description: Identifier of the admin who updated the reel

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized administrator record for Stackd Bombay brand portal

/site_media/{mediaId}.description: Published media assets accessible to public website visitors across all devices

/reels/{reelId}.description: Published customer review video reels visible to public visitors
